title: German Beef Stew
description: Hearty and comforting, this German beef stew is perfect for a chilly evening. The velvety texture from the addition of beer gives it a rich flavor.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef, then remove it from the pot.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the beef broth, beer, tomato paste, and flour to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
Stir in the velvety mustard, if using.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
